name: ms-self-teacher-pilot-budget-1gpu
description: Self-teacher soft targets for the multi-select decision experiment: Qwen3.5-4B with thinking enabled, 2 independent chains per question, 8 vLLM replicas over train+dev. Writes data/multiselect/self_teacher_{train,dev}.jsonl and self_teacher_summary.json; resumable per shard. CreateJob dry-run first; this payload is not submitted by the harness author.
command:
set -uo pipefail
R=/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/DiffRwkv/decision_compare
export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1
PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
cd "$R"
mkdir -p "$R/logs/qz" "$R/runs/qz/ms_self_teacher_pilot"
MAX_TOKENS=4096 MAX_MODEL_LEN=8192 SHARDS=1 THINKING_BUDGET=1024 DATA_DIR="$R/data/multiselect_pilot" PARTS_ROOT="$R/runs/qz/ms_self_teacher_pilot_budget/parts" SUMMARY="$R/data/multiselect_pilot/summary_budget.json" LOG_DIR="$R/logs/qz" bash "$R/harness/run_ms_self_teacher.sh" > "$R/logs/qz/ms_self_teacher_pilot_budget.log" 2>&1
status=$?
echo "JOB EXIT=$status"
exit $status
